name: gl_system_account_mapping_integrity
preconditionSql: SELECT to_regclass('public.system_account_mappings') IS NULL AND to_regclass('public.gl_accounts') IS NOT NULL AND to_regclass('public.treasuries') IS NOT NULL AND to_regclass('public.branches') IS NOT NULL AND to_regclass('public.posting_batches') IS NOT NULL AND to_regclass('public.journal_entries') IS NOT NULL AND to_regclass('public.journal_lines') IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT version FROM public.schema_migrations ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1)='0033' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.gl_accounts ch JOIN public.gl_accounts p ON p.id=ch.parent_id WHERE ch.company_id IS DISTINCT FROM p.company_id OR ch.parent_id=ch.id) AND NOT EXISTS (WITH RECURSIVE path AS (SELECT id AS root,parent_id,ARRAY[id] AS visited,false AS cycle FROM public.gl_accounts UNION ALL SELECT p.root,a.parent_id,p.visited || a.id,a.id=ANY(p.visited) FROM path p JOIN public.gl_accounts a ON a.id=p.parent_id WHERE NOT p.cycle) SELECT 1 FROM path WHERE cycle) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.journal_entries je JOIN public.posting_batches pb ON je.posting_batch_id=pb.id WHERE je.branch_id IS DISTINCT FROM pb.branch_id OR je.source_type IS DISTINCT FROM pb.source_type OR je.source_id IS DISTINCT FROM pb.source_id OR je.created_by IS DISTINCT FROM pb.created_by OR je.posted_at IS DISTINCT FROM pb.posted_at) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.journal_lines jl JOIN public.journal_entries je ON je.id=jl.journal_entry_id JOIN public.branches b ON b.id=je.branch_id JOIN public.gl_accounts g ON g.id=jl.gl_account_id WHERE g.company_id IS DISTINCT FROM b.company_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.journal_entries je WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.journal_lines jl WHERE jl.journal_entry_id=je.id)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.journal_lines jl JOIN public.gl_accounts child ON child.parent_id=jl.gl_account_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.journal_entries re JOIN public.journal_entries orig ON orig.id=re.reversal_of_entry_id JOIN public.posting_batches pb ON pb.id=re.posting_batch_id WHERE re.branch_id IS DISTINCT FROM orig.branch_id OR re.source_type IS DISTINCT FROM orig.source_type OR re.source_id IS DISTINCT FROM orig.source_id OR pb.reverses_posting_batch_id IS DISTINCT FROM orig.posting_batch_id OR pb.operation_type NOT IN ('REVERSAL','DELETE_REVERSAL')) AS ok;
verificationSql: SELECT to_regclass('public.system_account_mappings') IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pg_attribute WHERE attrelid='public.system_account_mappings'::regclass AND attnum>0 AND NOT attisdropped)=7 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid='public.system_account_mappings'::regclass AND conname IN ('pk_system_account_mappings','uq_system_account_mappings__role_target','ck_system_account_mappings__scope','ck_system_account_mappings__role_format','fk_system_account_mappings__company','fk_system_account_mappings__account','fk_system_account_mappings__actor'))=7 AND to_regprocedure('public.fn_gl_system_account_mapping_validate()') IS NOT NULL AND to_regprocedure('public.fn_gl_account_hierarchy_guard()') IS NOT NULL AND to_regprocedure('public.fn_mapped_treasury_guard()') IS NOT NULL AND to_regprocedure('public.fn_branch_company_immutable()') IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pg_trigger WHERE NOT tgisinternal AND tgname IN ('bt_system_account_mappings__validate','bt_gl_accounts__hierarchy_guard','bt_treasuries__mapped_context','bt_branches__company_immutable'))=4 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pg_index i JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=i.indrelid LEFT JOIN pg_constraint con ON con.conindid=i.indexrelid WHERE c.oid='public.system_account_mappings'::regclass AND con.oid IS NULL)=0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgrelid='public.journal_lines'::regclass AND tgname='ct_journal_entries__balanced_at_commit' AND tgdeferrable AND tginitdeferred) AS ok;
recovery: 0034 is an atomic forward-only migration; any failure before COMMIT rolls back schema and history. After COMMIT repair with another versioned forward migration; never alter 0034 checksum.
